This pass applies only to the submitted available and missing cases.

criteria.evidence: The complete export target visibly separates “Format and setup,” “Export status,” and “Results and warnings” with headings and dividers; setup guidance is further grouped beneath the format list.

HTML, PDF, DOCX, and EPUB appear as consistent primary format rows with blue labels, availability status, and chevrons. The installation guide is subordinate to the format choices, while the inactive job and result areas use concise explanatory text appropriate to the pre-export state.

The installation guide is clearly legible as a recovery/setup action. No output action is expected before a format is selected, and the panel explicitly explains where completed output and warnings will appear.

The complete target visibly maintains separate format/setup, export-status, and results/warnings sections. Within setup, the missing DOCX/EPUB capability is paired with a dedicated installation/configuration group.

HTML and PDF remain prominent actionable rows marked “Available,” while DOCX and EPUB are visually subdued and explicitly marked “Setup required.” Installation guide and Configure Pandoc controls are grouped directly below as the next actions.

Both “Installation guide” and “Configure Pandoc” are readable, full-width recovery actions. No output action is required in this pre-export state, and the results area clearly states that completed output and warnings will appear there.

evaluation.summary: Both submitted Running and canceling states are fully assessable and visually satisfy the export-panel criteria. The panel preserves distinct setup, status, and results areas; presents truthful current-stage messaging without fabricated progress; and keeps relevant actions readable and appropriately enabled or disabled.

criteria.evidence: The complete target is visible in both renders and is divided by clear headings and rules into Format and setup, Export status, and Results and warnings. Format availability and installation guidance are grouped coherently within the first section.

Export in progress is the dominant status, Cancel export is immediately adjacent, and the ordered stage list clearly distinguishes two Completed stages from the bold Current stage, Preparing referenced resources. No percentage or unsupported completion amount is shown.

Cancel export and Installation guide are legible blue actions with adequate control bounds. The results area truthfully explains that completed output and warnings will appear there; absence of an output action is appropriate while the export is still running.
The full and target renders show the complete panel with distinct Format and setup, Export status, and Results and warnings groups, separated through headings, spacing, and dividers.

The status prominently reads Cancellation requested. Waiting for confirmation…, while the stage list continues to identify completed checks and the current resource-preparation stage. This is a clear, truthful awaiting-host hierarchy without invented progress.

Installation guide remains legible, and Cancel export is visibly disabled after cancellation has been requested, preventing a misleading repeat action. The results placeholder remains readable and appropriately contains no output action before host confirmation or completion.

evaluation.summary: Both submitted states preserve the required anchored Export submenu structure, with clearly separated format/setup, status, and results/warnings areas. The failure state provides readable retry and installation recovery; the completed state truthfully presents completed host stages, a recorded output path, an open action, and a bounded warning count. This pass applies only to the submitted failure and completion-with-warnings cases.

evaluation.summary: The narrow completed export panel preserves the required grouped format/setup, job-status, and results/warnings structure. Stage completion is clearly presented, and the output and warning actions remain legible and accessible within the narrow viewport.

criteria.evidence: Both the full and target renders show visibly separated sections for Format and setup, Export status, and Results and warnings, using headings and crisp dividers; the complete target is visible without clipping.
